dialogue.content: （よろしくお願い致します）
dialogue.English: (Thank you in advance.)

dialogue.content: （おはようございます。よろしくお願します。１０時になりましたら、始めようと思いますが、大丈夫でしょうか？）
dialogue.English: (Good morning. Thank you for being here. It's 10 o'clock, so I thought we could begin. Is that alright with you?)

dialogue.content: （はい！）
dialogue.English: (Yes!)

dialogue.content: （では、はじめますね）おはようございます。相談員です。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: (Okay, let's begin.) Good morning. I'm your counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 仕事に行きたくなくて…
dialogue.English: I don't want to go to work...

dialogue.content: 今日おやすみしました
dialogue.English: I took the day off today.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。何か、行きたくない理由がありましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. Was there a particular reason you didn't want to go?

dialogue.content: はい、もう職場が嫌なんです…
dialogue.English: Yes, I really can’t stand my workplace anymore...

dialogue.content: 仕事してる人を信用できないです
dialogue.English: I can't trust the people I work with.

dialogue.content: それは、仕事をされていても、辛いですね。例えば、どんな時にそう感じますか？
dialogue.English: That must make it very difficult to work. For example, when do you feel that way?

dialogue.content: 怒鳴られた時とかですね…
dialogue.English: Like when I get yelled at...

dialogue.content: なんで怒鳴るんだろう？っていうのがわからない
dialogue.English: I don't understand why they have to yell.

dialogue.content: それは、、、誰に怒鳴られるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: And... who is it that yells at you?

dialogue.content: 先輩です
dialogue.English: A senior colleague.

dialogue.content: 職場で怒鳴られたら、嫌な気分になりますよね。どんな時に怒鳴られるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Being yelled at at work must feel awful. In what kinds of situations do they yell at you?

dialogue.content: よく分からないんです。何に怒っているのか…
dialogue.English: I’m not really sure what they’re angry about...

dialogue.content: 私は悪いとは思わないことなので
dialogue.English: Because I don't think I'm doing anything wrong.

dialogue.content: 怒られても（？）って感じです
dialogue.English: So even when they yell at me, I'm just left feeling confused.

dialogue.content: 納得できない事で怒鳴られたら、嫌な気持ちになると思います。いつから、そんな状態が続いていますか？
dialogue.English: I imagine it feels terrible to be yelled at for something you don't think is your fault. How long has this been going on?

dialogue.content: ４月頃からです
dialogue.English: Since around April.

dialogue.content: では、もう、７か月近く続いているのですね。そんな状態の中、仕事をされてきたのですね
dialogue.English: So, it's been going on for nearly seven months now. You've been working under those conditions all this time.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 怒鳴られているのは、あなただけでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you the only one who gets yelled at?

dialogue.content: 多分そうです
dialogue.English: I think so.

dialogue.content: 目の敵にされてる感じ
dialogue.English: It feels like I'm being targeted.

dialogue.content: 私が悪いのかな…
dialogue.English: Maybe it's my fault...

dialogue.content: 自分に怒鳴られる原因があると考えたりされているのですね、、、それは、なおさら辛いですね、、、４月前までは、先輩は貴方に対してどうでしたか？
dialogue.English: So you're wondering if you're the cause of the yelling... That must make it even harder... Before April, how did this senior colleague treat you?

dialogue.content: ４月前は違うところにいたので
dialogue.English: Before April, I was in a different department.

dialogue.content: なるほど。４月に貴方がいまの部署に入ってこられたのですか？それとも、先輩が？
dialogue.English: I see. In April, was it you who joined the current department, or was it the senior colleague?

dialogue.content: 私です
dialogue.English: I was the one.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。先輩のいる部署に貴方が入って来られてから直ぐに、皆の前で、あなただけが怒鳴られているといった状況なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So, did this situation start right after you joined your senior colleague's department? And were you the only one being yelled at in front of everyone?

dialogue.content: みんなの前ではないのですが
dialogue.English: It's not in front of everyone.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 常にこそこそやってますね
dialogue.English: They always do it sneakily.

dialogue.content: 他の人に悪口も言っているのだと思います
dialogue.English: I think they're also badmouthing me to other people.

dialogue.content: この前も内線で悪口話していたし
dialogue.English: The other day, they were talking badly about me on the internal line, too.

dialogue.content: 内線で？どんな状況かお聞きしてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: On the internal line? Could you tell me more about that situation?

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 内線で他の人に悪口言ってて
dialogue.English: They were badmouthing me to someone else on the internal line,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: その人のところへ私が現れると
dialogue.English: and when I showed up at that person’s desk,

dialogue.content: じゃあまたね！って感じで電話切って
dialogue.English: they hung up, saying something like, "Okay, talk to you later!"

dialogue.content: すごい腹が立ちました
dialogue.English: I was so furious.

dialogue.content: そう思っても仕方のない状況ですね
dialogue.English: That's a completely understandable reaction to that situation.

dialogue.content: そのような事を上司の方にご相談されてみましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you tried speaking to your supervisor about this?

dialogue.content: 上司もダメダメなので
dialogue.English: My supervisor is useless, too.

dialogue.content: というか
dialogue.English: Or rather,

dialogue.content: 上司にその先輩が私のこと相談して泣いていて
dialogue.English: that senior colleague was crying to my supervisor while complaining about me,

dialogue.content: それを見てしまって
dialogue.English: and I happened to see it.

dialogue.content: なんと、、、
dialogue.English: Oh my...

dialogue.content: え、辛いのは私なんですけど…と諦めました
dialogue.English: I just gave up, thinking, "Wait, I'm the one who's suffering here..."

dialogue.content: 人格を疑いますよね
dialogue.English: It makes you question their character, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: その後、上司の方は何かあなたに言われたりしましたか？
dialogue.English: After that, did your supervisor say anything to you?

dialogue.content: いいえ、なにも。
dialogue.English: No, nothing at all.

dialogue.content: 辞めたいと言いにいったのですが
dialogue.English: I went to tell them I wanted to quit, but...

dialogue.content: 辞めてどうするの？あなたになにができるの？と
dialogue.English: they asked, 'What will you do if you quit? What are you even capable of?'

dialogue.content: 上司の方が、そんなことを、、
dialogue.English: Your supervisor said that to you...?

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そういわれて、どの様に感じましたか？
dialogue.English: How did you feel when they said that?

dialogue.content: ちょっとそうなのかな…
dialogue.English: I wondered if maybe they were right...

dialogue.content: って
dialogue.English: I thought,

dialogue.content: 私には何もできないから
dialogue.English: because I can't do anything.

dialogue.content: 自分には他に何も出来ないのではないか、、、と感じたのですね？
dialogue.English: So you felt that you might not be capable of doing anything else?

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そう自分で考えるのは、なぜでしょう？
dialogue.English: Why do you think you feel that way about yourself?

dialogue.content: わかりません
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: 今まで、他に何かお仕事はされた事はありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you had any other jobs before this one?

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。どんな事を？
dialogue.English: I see. What kind of work did you do?

dialogue.content: 保育園の先生です
dialogue.English: I was a preschool teacher.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。いつまでそのお仕事はされていましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. When did you leave that job?

dialogue.content: ３年前です
dialogue.English: Three years ago.

dialogue.content: その時は、どんなお気持ちでお仕事をされていたんでしょう
dialogue.English: How did you feel about your work at that time?

dialogue.content: 楽しかったですよその時は
dialogue.English: It was fun back then.

dialogue.content: それは素敵です。楽しかったお仕事をお辞めになった理由は何かありましたか？話せる範囲でよいので、教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: That’s wonderful. Was there a reason you left a job you enjoyed? Please feel free to share only what you're comfortable with.

dialogue.content: 今の仕事につきたかったからです
dialogue.English: Because I wanted to get the job I have now.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 楽しかった先生のお仕事を辞められてまで就いたお仕事でなんですね。では、もう３年近く、今のお仕事をされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So this is a job you wanted so much that you left a teaching position you enjoyed. Does that mean you've been at your current job for nearly three years now?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そんな風に選ばれてきて、３年もされてきたお仕事で、今、そんな辛い状況にあるというのは、なんともやりきれない思いですね。
dialogue.English: It must be incredibly disheartening to be in such a painful situation now, in a job you chose and have been doing for three years.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 先ほど、上司の方に、辞めたいと言われたとの事でしたが、そのお気持ちは今もおありでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Earlier you mentioned telling your supervisor you wanted to quit. Do you still feel that way?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お話を聞いていて、今の状況は、いじめに近いものがある様に感じます。上司の方も対応してくださっていないようですし
dialogue.English: I see. Listening to you, it sounds like what you're experiencing is close to bullying. And it seems your supervisor isn't addressing it, either.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 辛い状況で、今日は会社も休まれてしまわれてます。今、体調は如何ですか？眠れてますか？
dialogue.English: It's such a tough situation that you had to take today off from work. How are you feeling physically? Are you able to sleep?

dialogue.content: ほぼ眠れません
dialogue.English: I can barely sleep.

dialogue.content: 2時間ごとに目が覚めます
dialogue.English: I wake up every two hours.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、、お仕事を続けると、身体が心配ですね。本当にこのままでは、、、と思われるなら、お仕事を辞められるのも選択肢になると思います。貴方は、先生として楽しくお仕事をされていた経験もおありです。何も出来ない人ではないと思いますよ。まずは、お身体を回復させてほしいな、と思いますが、、、
dialogue.English: I see... I'm worried about your health if you continue working like this. If you truly feel you can't go on, I believe quitting is a valid option. You have experience enjoying your work as a teacher; I don't think you're someone who is incapable of doing anything. First and foremost, however, I would like you to prioritize your physical recovery.

dialogue.content: でも辞めても何もできないと言われて辞めさせてもらえません
dialogue.English: But they told me I can't do anything if I quit, so they won't let me resign.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: 辞めたいのに辞めさせてもらえない、という事ですか？
dialogue.English: So you want to quit, but they won't let you?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 話に行ったのに
dialogue.English: Even though I went to talk to them about it.

dialogue.content: もし、本気で辞めると決めていらっしゃっるのであれば、今、身体にも症状が出ていますし、診断書を貰って人事などに言えば辞めさせてもらえないという事はないとは思うのですが。どうでしょうか
dialogue.English: If you're serious about your decision to quit, considering you're already experiencing physical symptoms, I think it's unlikely they could refuse if you were to get a doctor's note and take it to HR. What do you think?

dialogue.content: まずは、ご自分を守らないと
dialogue.English: You have to protect yourself first.

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: You're right...

dialogue.content: 精神的にもこのままだと良くないと思うのですが
dialogue.English: I believe this isn't good for your mental well-being either, if things continue as they are.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お辛い状況だと思います。
dialogue.English: I know this must be a very painful situation for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もう少しお時間があればよかったのですが、すみません。時間がきてしまい申し訳ありません。もし、辞表を出されて、それでも駄目な場合は、公的機関にご相談されてもいいと思います。
dialogue.English: I wish we had more time, but I'm afraid our session is over, my apologies. If you submit your resignation and it's still not accepted, I think you could consult with a public agency.

dialogue.content: 貴方は何も出来ない人ではありません。でも、今は、先ず、ご自分の回復を優先されて下さい。
dialogue.English: You are not someone who can't do anything. But for now, please prioritize your own recovery.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 今日はこれで終わりますが、いつでもまた、ご相談にいらしてください。
dialogue.English: We'll end here for today, but please feel free to come back and talk anytime.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: どうか、お身体を大切にされてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Please, take good care of yourself.

dialogue.content: これで失礼します。
dialogue.English: I'll sign off now.
